tabs.description: Tabs organize content into multiple sections with pill-shaped backgrounds. Selected tabs have white background with subtle shadow, unselected tabs are transparent with gray text.
when_to_use: Switching between product categories (ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI)
Filtering content demos (AI Voice Generator, Text to Speech, Music, etc.)
Navigation between related views within a section

states.name: selected
states.visual_change: White background with subtle box-shadow: 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04)

states.name: hover
states.visual_change: Cream/gray-200 background appears on hover, text transitions to black
